name: Meippai☆Athlete
original_name: めいっぱい☆あすりぃと
source:
Let's open a joint college festival for three schools! Such was the suggestion of main character to the student council. Somehow the plan is carried out and now the girl school, the geek school and the celebrity school are in the midst of joint preparation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“让三所学校联合举办大学园祭吧！”主人公向学生会提出了这样的建议。计划不知怎的得以实施，如今女子学校、御宅族学校和名流学校正在共同筹备活动。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
